description: Quick test to verify agent dispatch and output.

agent_notes.else: 2026-04-10: Completed fintech brand research brief for Vault. Surveyed 7 competitor/comparable brands (Revolut, Wise, Mercury, Brex, Stripe, Monzo, Chime). Documented color palettes, typography choices, tagline styles, and brand voice for each. Key findings: blue/indigo and green dominate the visual landscape; warm gold/amber is completely unclaimed; no fintech uses serif type as a primary element; calm-authority voice posture (protection, custody, long-term value) is white space. Recommended positioning: deep warm near-black + burnished gold, contemporary serif headlines, unhurried/certain tone. Output: output/test-run/strategy/2026-04-10-fintech-brand-research.md. Ready for jorunn (brand kit creation).
agent_notes.jorunn: 2026-04-10: Completed brand brief for Focus. Defined primary audience (24-40 output-driven professionals on unstable app stacks), three tone pillars (Direct, Calm, Honest) with do/don't copy examples, and a single-sentence value proposition anchored on the task-to-focus transition gap. Output: output/test-run/brand/2026-04-10-brand-brief-positioning-tone-value-proposition.md. Ready for ingrid (color palette, visual direction).
agent_notes.ingrid: 2026-04-10: Completed color palette and full UI/UX layout spec for FocusFlow landing page. Color palette: Calm Indigo #4361B8 (primary), Deep Slate #1E2D3D (surface), Focused Amber #F5A623 (accent/active sessions). Layout spec: hero wireframe with eyebrow label, H1, subheadline, CTA; 3-column feature grid with card structure (icon+title+description), responsive grid (1-col mobile, 3-col desktop); minimal footer (brand left, nav right). Full design token set for colors/typography/spacing. Component states documented (hover/active/focus with Amber focus ring). Accessibility checklist included. HTML outline for arve. Both docs reference jorunn's copy and bjorn's technical spec — arve should read all three. Outputs: output/test-run/brand/2026-04-10-color-palette-suggestion.md and output/test-run/brand/2026-04-10-uiux-layout-spec.md. Ready for arve (implementation).
agent_notes.jorunn_copy: 2026-04-10: Completed landing page copy for FocusFlow. Positioning statement anchors on single-action task-to-focus transition. Hero headline: 'One tap from task to focus.' Subheadline in 3 sentences, no friction language. CTA: 'Start Focusing'. Features: Focus Blocks (timed sessions, one tap), Distraction Shield (mutes interruptions by default), Daily Recap (honest time accounting, no spin). Footer tagline: 'Work starts here.' All copy follows Direct/Calm/Honest tone pillars. Includes copy-don't list and character counts for arve. Output: output/test-run/brand/2026-04-10-landing-page-copy.md. Ready for arve (implementation).
agent_notes.bjorn: 2026-04-10: Completed technical specification for FocusFlow single-file landing page. Specified HTML section layout (header, hero, features grid, footer), CSS custom properties for all color/type/spacing tokens (sourced from ingrid's palette), flat BEM-lite class naming convention, two responsive breakpoints (640px, 768px), and micro-interaction patterns for CTA button, ghost button, feature cards, and sticky header scroll. All color tokens reference ingrid's Calm Indigo/Deep Slate/Focused Amber palette. No open decisions. Output: output/test-run/architecture/2026-04-10-technical-specification.md. Ready for arve (implementation).
agent_notes.halvard: 2026-04-10: Completed target audience and value proposition for Focus. Primary audience: Deep Work Professional (25-38, individual contributor, output-measured role, hybrid/remote). Top 3 pain points with measurable cost: (1) task-to-focus handoff costs ~45-60 min/day in context-switching, (2) no honest capacity view drives end-of-day uncertainty and churn, (3) multi-tool stack coordination overhead scales with seniority. Core value proposition: 'Focus closes the gap between knowing what to do and doing it — in a single gesture, on every device.' Growth implication: PLG motion with 90-second demonstrable habit loop; target time-to-first-completed-focus-session under 3 minutes. Output: output/test-run/strategy/2026-04-10-target-audience-value-proposition.md.
agent_notes.jorunn_brand_brief: 2026-04-10: Completed consolidated one-page brand brief for Focus. Synthesized else's market research, halvard's audience/value prop, existing jorunn tone work, and ingrid's color palette into a single reference document. Four sections: (1) Target Audience — Deep Work Professional, 25-38, output-measured individual contributor; (2) Tone of Voice — Direct, Calm, Honest, each with do/don't copy examples; (3) Core Value Proposition — task-to-focus transition as the product, single gesture, every device; (4) Color Palette — Calm Indigo #4361B8, Deep Slate #1E2D3D, Focused Amber #F5A623, with usage rules. Output: output/test-run/brand/2026-04-10-focus-brand-brief.md.
agent_notes.arve: 2026-04-10: Completed FocusFlow landing page implementation. Single self-contained index.html with all CSS inlined. Upstream inputs read: bjorn's technical spec (CSS tokens, BEM-lite naming, micro-interactions, breakpoints), ingrid's color palette + UX layout spec (wireframes, card structure, component states, accessibility), jorunn's landing page copy (used verbatim). Sections implemented: sticky header with wordmark + ghost CTA button; hero with amber eyebrow dot, H1 headline, 3-sentence subheadline, amber CTA; 3-column responsive feature grid (collapses to 1-col below 768px) with inline SVG icons, feature names, and descriptions; CTA band with footer tagline; footer with brand/copyright left and nav links right. All design tokens from bjorn's spec. Scroll listener for sticky header shadow. Focus styles use Focused Amber (#F5A623) per accessibility checklist. Output: output/test-run/implementation/2026-04-10-landing-page.html.
agent_notes.jorunn_vault_brand_kit: 2026-04-10: Completed Vault brand kit. Upstream input: else's fintech brand research (7 competitor profiles, white space analysis). Deliverables: (1) 5-color palette — Vault Black #171210 (warm near-black, unclaimed in fintech), Burnished Gold #B89030 (primary accent, completely unclaimed), Bone White #F3EEE4, Vault Slate #2C2520, Warm Stone #8C7B6B; (2) Typography — DM Serif Display (headings, first serif in fintech category) + DM Sans (body, same family for coherence); (3) Tagline — 'Where money is kept.' — 4 words, declarative, no exclamation, activates vault metaphor without being literal; (4) Brand voice — calm authority posture, vocabulary do/don't list, 4 example phrases at different copy lengths. Output: output/test-run/brand/2026-04-10-vault-brand-kit.md. Ready for ingrid (visual review and polish).
agent_notes.ingrid_visual_qa: 2026-04-11: Completed visual QA review of Vault brand kit (jorunn). WCAG 2.1 AA audit found 2 issues: (1) Warm Stone #8C7B6B on Vault Slate #2C2520 = 3.71:1 — fails AA for normal text; corrected to #9E8E7E (4.76:1 on Vault Slate, 5.86:1 on Vault Black); (2) Burnished Gold #B89030 on Bone White #F3EEE4 = 2.57:1 — fails all sizes; constraint added: gold must not be used as text on light backgrounds; new Deep Gold #7A5F1A token added for light-mode gold text (5.22:1 on Bone White). Palette cohesion passes — warm undertones consistent throughout. Typography (DM Serif Display + DM Sans) passes — no changes. Visual QA Notes appended directly to brand kit file and written separately. Output: output/test-run/brand/2026-04-11-vault-visual-qa-notes.md.
